description: Tanya Lakins is running for Missouri House of Representatives District 39 to deliver practical leadership for Clay County families. Her campaign focuses on reaching across the aisle and delivering results by strengthening public education, supporting veterans and military families, expanding economic opportunity, and ensuring accountable government for communities like Kearney, Excelsior Springs, and Liberty.
title: Lakins for Missouri | District 39 | Clay County, MO, USA
